intentIngestion.description: Transforms UI form state and natural prompt into an immutable IntentPackage IR with SHA-256 intentHash.

strategicDiscovery.description: Discovers mechanical capability clusters and selects viable lines from empirical pool density with strategicMemoryHash.

gameplanSynthesis.description: Synthesizes executable turn requirements, windows, and required engines. Hashes structural payload excluding presentation prose.

searchSpaceRestiction.description: Applies format legality, color identity, allowOffTribe gate, and Gameplan role proof obligations to emit candidate frontier.

stateConstruction.description: Iteratively transitions S0 -> S_target using StateCandidateRanker and ContextualCardCompetition state comparison.

candidateRanking.description: Compares state transitions S+A vs S+B across 9-layer lexicographic Pareto dominance vector.

contextualCardCompetition.description: Strict helper invoked by StateCandidateRanker to modulate tribalPreference opportunity cost in state comparison.

manaOptimization.description: Solves optimal land base for fixed non-land spells. Formalizes transition DeckState(S) -> DeckState(S') with manaHash.

simulationExecution.description: Seeded deterministic Monte Carlo simulation (PRNG) observing playability, curve execution, and win turns.

judicialCertification.description: Audits 14 deterministic axes, enforces gameplan coverage, executes bounded replanning via ReplanExecutor or issues final REJECT.

legacyAdapters.description: Físicamente aislados. Sus outputs jamás entran en Gameplan, Frontier, Ranker, DeckState, Mana ni Judge.

illustrativeTelemetry.description: Etiquetados como evidenceType: 'ILLUSTRATIVE'. assertDecisionSafeEvidence() bloquea su uso en cualquier decisión.
